title: Quintessential Juicy Australian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and adventurous Australian dish featuring ground ginger and tender beef, cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven. This stew is buttery, juicy, and full of flavor.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground ginger, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth and tomato paste, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours.
Use a meat thermometer to ensure the beef is cooked to a safe internal temperature of 160 degrees.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
